source_model_prompt:
A single game-item icon illustration of one broad sage-green leaf partially curled UPWARD at its top edge like a simple thick scroll, the curved leading lip visibly rolls toward the TOP. One simple chunky leaf, no extra props, no stem below that could look like a face. Render in exactly the same visual family as the THREE attached approved reference images: reference 1 golden planter D for matte volume and lighting, reference 2 red mushroom for softly painted 3D illustration, reference 3 related approved function icon for visual weight. References guide STYLE, do not copy their objects unless the subject explicitly calls for them.

Soft matte clay-like 3D, smooth plump rounded volumes, gentle top-left key light, softly painted core shading, a faint soft highlight, crisp clean silhouette with NO outline. No texture noise. Palette: warm honey-gold #F5C55A (light #FFE7A0, shade #C98F2A), sage green, warm browns, cream #FFF1DB, coral red #F36C63 as the only high-saturation accent. Never shiny metal, chrome or plastic; no specular glare. A thick simple readable silhouette, one main object with at most one or two supporting details, no tiny decorative marks. At 96px all key parts must remain legible.

Centered square canvas, 1254x1254 transparent RGBA PNG. Object fills about 84%, about 8% safe margin on EVERY side. No background, frame, enclosing circle, scene, ground plane or cast shadow outside the object; only an extremely faint contact shadow is allowed.

DO NOT add faces, eyes, mouths, anthropomorphic bodies, hands, arms, feet, characters, text, letters, numbers, fake writing, sparkles, glitter, thick black outlines, sticker borders, flat vector, line-art, emoji style, glass glare or neon. Only ONE icon, never a contact sheet or comparisons.
